title: București · Vasile Alecsandri → Armenească

contextualBodies.reason: The separate modern building forms the visible south-east enclosure of the Armeneasca square. Its complete official footprint is included as contextual architecture, without extending the public-space surfaces. The footprint is approximately 4.24 m outside the ground coverage; no native OSM building association is confirmed.

pavedAreas.evidence: Red-paved diagonal paths and three planted islands traced approximately from the official 2020 orthophoto; July 2025 Street View confirms red paving, grass, low hedges, conifers, a red memorial stele and a roadside bus shelter. Vegetation and furniture supplied by the runtime layer.

crossingEvidence: Four crossing positions checked against both official orthophoto dates. North/west corners also have OSM crossing/flush-kerb nodes. Exact stripe dimensions are estimated.
axisEvidence: Official Strazi_RM axis is approximately 2.6 m north of the existing OSM-based Alecsandri junction. Existing VA05/VA06 ownership is preserved. New pavement tapers continuously from the exact retained road edges at x658 to the official axis at x680; estimated carriageway width changes from 8.8 to 9.2 m. The eastern approach x793..805 returns to the existing OSM axis z470 to maintain continuity. Armeneasca follows the OSM/orthophoto-aligned junction at x776.1 with an estimated 10.6 m carriageway.
evidence: Official cadastral data contain no heights or storey counts.
